params.body:
## Why

"Early access to a paid plan" (topic `trial`) was reachable only by picking it from the contact form's list; no button or link on the site led to it. It was also the only contact topic that became a Clay lead (`trial_request`), so the event fired rarely and stood apart from every other sales question.

## What

- The option leaves the contact form.
- The Clay route it fed goes with it: the `contact.received` mapping in `ClayAdapter`, `ClayLeads::REQUEST`, and the replay of trial messages in `gentells:clay-backfill`.
- Clay now receives two events: `trial_signup` and `newsletter_signup`. Rows already in Clay are untouched; old contact messages keep their topic.

## Tests

`ClayLeadsTest` and `ContactFormTest` adjusted and extended (the form no longer offers the topic; a contact message is no Clay lead). Full suite: the same 9 failures with and without this change, all from the local environment (OAuth keys, build stamp), none in the files touched. Pint clean.
params.title: Drop the trial topic from the contact form, and trial_request with it
